cover.headline: 15 stories in 5 minutes. Khamenei warns of a response with no limits, US OKs Patriots for Kyiv, FBI blames North Korea for Binance.

stories.head: Khamenei: respond with no geographic limits
body: Iran's leader ordered an immediate response to any US or Israeli attack. Washington has warned Gulf states of a possible offensive after the Nov. 3 midterms.
Tehran says it has no plans to meet US officials, yet calls Vance's letter a positive step. Qatar hosted 14 hours of talks.

stories.head: Patriot sale, Oleshky truce, Moscow alert
body: The US approved 500 Patriot PAC-3 missiles for Ukraine, about $2.1bn. Deliveries are not expected before the 2030s.
Evacuees left occupied Oleshky under a rare truce due to end Sunday at 23:00. The US warned of a threat at a Moscow museum.

stories.head: FBI points at North Korea for Binance hack
body: The FBI blames the group TraderTraitor for the attack on Binance, which the exchange put at about $6.3bn, Bloomberg reports.
The attribution is as reported by media. We have not seen the FBI statement itself.

stories.head: Midterms, Brazil, France and Tirana
body: US: Democrats lead polls by 8 points and over 43m have voted early. Brazil: Lula won with 51.8% and Flavio Bolsonaro flew to Miami without conceding.
France: 320,000 marched, down from 410,000, and 296 were detained. Tirana: students threw Molotovs at the government palace.

stories.head: Korea, Somalia, W. Sahara, Ebola, Sudan, Haiti
body: US, Seoul and Tokyo restated their denuclearisation demand. The UN closed its Somalia mission. Russia vetoed a Western Sahara text.
Ebola deaths in DR Congo passed 5,000. A top RSF commander says he defected. Salvadoran troops opened a base in Haiti.
